lines.en: We make our way out of the inn and it quickly becomes evident that Otoha regrets not dressing appropriately for the occasion.
I think about letting her borrow my blazer, but then decide even offering it is pointless because, if it really gets too cold for her, she can always zip her hoodie up.
Though, I really hope she doesn’t.
We walk in silence along the shoreline, trying to find somewhere to talk without anyone else seeing us, and I can’t help but find myself staring at her out of the corner of my eye.
And either she’s okay with it or just doesn’t notice because, even though I’m barely being discreet about it, she doesn’t say anything.
I think more about what could have possibly prompted her to invite me out, knowing that she’s perhaps less interested in me than even someone like Yumi-
And then I land on one thing and one thing only.
Rin.
How boring.
Which isn’t to say that Rin herself is boring. I like her a lot.
It’s just the idea of someone inviting me out to talk about romantic companionship (Or lack thereof) that doesn’t even involve me seems rather pointless in the long run.
But hey, people like to talk.
Otoha, if nothing else, is certainly a person.
A person who is likely going to try and figure out a way out of something bound to happen whether anyone wants it to or not-
But a person nonetheless.
And I have zero chance of sleeping with her in the future if I dismiss her over something as trivial as this.
If there is anything that walking alongside her on this beach has reinforced in my head, it is the desire to do just that.
But hey, maybe I’ll get really lucky and find out in this impromptu meeting that Otoha is just really horny and wants me to fuck her before anyone realizes we’re gone.
That would be the best case scenario.
Unfortunately, I don’t think I’ve encountered something that convenient since I first arrived in Kumon-mi.
Oh well.
I’ll just listen and hope that there’s something I can contribute to this conversation.
And store the sight of another sheltered girl’s fair skin in my mind to help me cum whenever I’m feeling lost or alone.
: This should be fine, right?
: Yeah.
: Interesting choice of location.
: Why? Because it’s a boat shaped like a banana?
: That’ll do it.
: It’s whatever.
: Not really sure what a random banana boat thing is doing in the middle of a circle of palm trees on the beach, but I was getting tired of walking, so...
: Maybe it’s a cult ritual site of some sorts.
: Like one of you girls secretly worships a banana-shaped god and set up this boat as a means of contacting him.
: Maybe.
: Or maybe somebody just left it here.
: My idea was significantly more exciting.
: More exciting, sure. A hell of a lot less plausible, though.
: Otoha...you didn’t call me out here to talk about bananas, did you?
: Of course not. I don’t even like bananas.
: Rin is going to be very happy when she hears that.
: Dude.
: What?
: You should be happy I made that joke. I saved you a segue.
: Hah...yeah. Yeah, you did.
: Figured you would have known that’s what this was about.
: What about her, though?
: You two have a complicated relationship, so I figure it could be almost anything.
: You think we have a complicated relationship? Because, at least from my perspective, the one you guys have seems a lot more complicated than just two girls who hang out and talk about music.
: I think Rin sees a little more in you than just a musician friend, Otoha.
: I obviously know that. But that’s all we are right now and that’s all we’ll be for a while.
: That’s not exactly what I’m thinking about right now, though.
: Are you going to tell me what you’re thinking? Or are we just going to hang out on a giant banana?
: Stop mentioning the banana.
: It is a hard aspect of this conversation to ignore.
: Then don’t mind if I ignore it and try to move things along because I am getting very cold.
: Have you like...talked to Rin at all today?
: Today? No.
: Was she like...acting weird the last time you talked to her or anything?
: Weird in what way?
: I don’t know.
: But she’s been acting a little different ever since she pulled you out of class the other day.
: Did you like...say anything to her or something?
: At the risk of revealing too much information, do you mind if I ask you why you think she’s acting weird?
: So, uhh...
: She confessed to Chika or whatever during your last beach trip, right?
: That was certainly a thing that happened.
: But Chika was, like...into you or something back then, right?
: Why do you ask?
: Are you worried Rin still has feelings for her or something?
: She liked her for years, dude. Am I insane for thinking that all of that would just vanish after spending a couple months hanging out with me?
: She obviously likes me too, but with how weird she’s been acting lately, I can’t help but feel like she might be...having flashbacks or something to last time.
: She’s not really easy to talk to when anything involving romance comes up.
: And I'm sure it's no surprise, but neither am I. I suck at it.
: But, not gonna lie, I think that a lot of her problem is a result of how shit went down back then.
: Finding out how the person you're into is...into somebody else you're close with is kind of a fucked up thing to deal with.
: That...That probably hurt her a lot.
: I mean...it’s not like I really did anything wrong though, right?
: Fuck if I know. I’d prefer to stay as far out of your personal life as I can.
: All I want is to figure out what’s going on so I can...adjust accordingly.
: I...obviously already know that things with that didn’t really end well, but...is it weird for me to think there might still be something there?
: Do you think that might be why she’s been acting weird lately?
: Cause she’s having like...PTSD beach flashbacks or something?
: Do you think that Rin still has feelings for Chika?
: She liked her for years, dude.
: I’m no expert on romance, but I don’t think that feelings like that just go away the second someone new shows up.
: Like...you two had a thing for a little while too, didn’t you?
: I don’t know if I’d call it a “thing” when all we did was kiss.
: Normally, probably not.
: But I think the fact that you’re twice her age kind of makes it a thing.
: If you had a normal friendship or student-teacher relationship or whatever, things like that wouldn’t happen.
: I guess what I’m getting at is that there are so many different reasons for her to be acting the way she is and I just...don’t understand any of them.
: And all I want is to figure out what’s going on so I can...adjust accordingly.
: Well, let me ask you this-
: What if the reason Rin’s acting weird is because of you?
: I haven’t even done anything differently, though.
: In fact, I was kinda stoked to spend the weekend hanging out with her.
: Rin’s a really awesome and fun girl as long as you figure out how to tune out the...insane amount of hormones.
: I think the hormones are another thing about her that just makes her as...entertaining as she is.
: I have no idea how she still feels about Chika...and I’m probably even more confused about how she feels about me-
: But I think the best thing you can do is ignore all of that and just think about how she feels about you.
: It’s not that easy, dude.
: I’ve seen her scars.
: I understand how much she must have been hurting to do something like that to herself.
: Being the current target for all of her affection...just makes it so that one wrong move on my part could get her to start doin' that shit again.
: It's so much pressure.
: Like...even if Rin feels a lot stronger about me than I do about her, I still care about her.
: She deserves happiness just as much as anybody else.
: And it really fucks me up to see her upset.
: So, yeah...I kinda just...don’t really know what to do about it.
: She’s even like...avoiding me now. And that’s never happened before.
: Feels a lot like a...calm before the storm type of thing.
: And what do you think that storm will be, exactly?
: I don’t know.
: I just hope it isn’t something that gets in the way of our friendship.
Ahh...there it is.
The semi-broodish resistance of a [teenage]girl pushing back a wave of feelings moving far too quickly for her to handle.
This type of thing is not uncommon in girls Otoha’s age- especially ones without any experience or even apparent interest in love or sex.
She just wants to enjoy her youth- and that is fine.
Unfortunately, it looks like someone may, once again, have to suffer as a result of that.
Maybe it would be best to let Rin know?
Or, maybe-
I should let her fail again.
Will that failure lead to her giving up on girls entirely?
Will it land her one step closer to my door?
Will she cry as she lays on my bed in defeat once again?
Or will she accept her place in both my life and hers and just learn to let things go?
: Anyway, I guess I’ll leave you to your giant banana now.
: I’m going to go put actual clothes back on and find out whether or not Nodoka lost her virginity to one of the girls who were arrested during our raid earlier.
: It’s honestly a miracle she still has it to begin with.
: I think that every single day.
: Thanks, though.
: And, if you see Rin, can you ask her to at least text me back?
: Sure thing.
: Have fun checking the virginity status of your roommate.
: Have fun with the banana.
Otoha leaves and I wind up “having fun with the banana” for a minute or two.
Please don’t interpret that the wrong way.
I’m really just sitting here thinking about, as Otoha put it, the calm before the storm.
I know we only have one other experience to work off of, but it feels like a beach trip without some form of tragedy would be no beach trip at all.
: Molly?
Right on cue.
: G...Greetings, Supreme Overlord.
: How long have you been there for?
: I was...in the middle of leveling up my stealth when...I saw you and Otoha walking, so...
: So you followed us?
: ...Yeah.
: How much did you hear?
: Not much, Sir. I had to stand rather far away to conceal my presence.
: I had every intention of leaving you behind and returning to the inn to complete my quest, but...
: I...I think I’m leveled up high enough to skip out on the XP for a little while longer.
: Does this mean it’s our turn to talk now?
: May I sit?
: As long as you’re okay with the seat being a giant banana.
Molly takes a seat on the banana boat and peers up at the sun through the leaves of the palm trees.
As if the idea of the calm before the storm was not enough the first time it was brought up, she had to show up now of all times and remind me of just how much is at stake this weekend.
Perhaps everyone will be damaged beyond repair and I’ll be around to pick up the pieces?
Why does the thought of that not excite me even half as much as it should?
: Molly-
: I’m already prepared for it, Sir.
: Prepared for what?
: TPK.
: A total party kill, rather.
: The only issue is that this druid is currently in between groups and running a party of one.
: It’s a lonely campaign.
: But...I’ll be able to start again on a new character soon enough.
: I know it’s coming.
: And I know things do not look good for the main heroine.
: But...that’s just the thing with main heroines, Sir.
: Sometimes, our happiness is pushed back to the very end.
: Perhaps that’s what’s happening this time.
: Or perhaps I’m no main heroine at all?
: Either way...I’m prepared.
: I have to be prepared.
: If Rin thinks Otoha is the one who can make her happy...I’ll just have to make someone else happy.
: Damn it...
: Would it make you feel better if we hugged on a banana boat?
: Hahah...
: Maybe for a moment...
: I do...have to be getting back to the Kendo Princess, though.
: She’s embarking on a quest of her own right now that...may or may not have its own set of difficulties.
: A quest of her own?
Meanwhile...further down the shore...
